- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.

# Liberal Democrats Manifesto 2024 Summary

The Liberal Democrats' 2024 manifesto outlines a comprehensive policy platform across multiple areas, presenting their vision for governance.

## Economic Policy
The party proposes managing public finances responsibly while investing in green infrastructure and renewable energy. Key economic measures include replacing business rates with a Commercial Landowner Levy, reforming capital gains tax, increasing the Digital Services Tax from 2% to 6%, and expanding apprenticeships. They advocate fixing trade relationships with Europe and creating a new industrial strategy focused on skills development.

## Healthcare and Social Care
The manifesto commits to guaranteeing GP appointments within seven days (24 hours for urgent cases) by recruiting 8,000 additional GPs. Proposals include expanding mental health services, improving cancer treatment timelines, and introducing free personal care based on Scotland's model. The party plans to establish a Royal College of Care Workers and increase the Carer's Minimum Wage by £2 per hour.

## Environment and Energy
Environmental priorities include achieving net zero by 2045, generating 90% of electricity from renewables by 2030, and launching a home energy upgrade programme. The manifesto addresses water pollution through stricter regulations on sewage discharge, proposes transforming water companies into public benefit companies, and commits to planting 60 million trees annually.

## Education
Education proposals include placing mental health professionals in every school, increasing per-pupil funding above inflation, providing tutoring guarantees for disadvantaged pupils, reinstating maintenance grants for students, and creating £5,000 Lifelong Skills Grants for adult education.

## Housing
The party targets building 380,000 homes annually, including 150,000 social homes. They propose banning no-fault evictions, creating three-year default tenancies, abolishing residential leaseholds, and establishing a Rent to Own scheme for social housing.

## Immigration and Asylum
The manifesto proposes scrapping the Rwanda scheme, creating safe legal routes for refugees, processing asylum claims within three months, and allowing asylum seekers to work after three months. They advocate reforming work visa systems with sector-specific approaches.

## Political Reform
Democratic reforms include introducing proportional representation (Single Transferable Vote) for MPs and English councillors, lowering voting age to 16, capping political donations, reforming the House of Lords, and scrapping voter ID requirements.

## Defence and International Relations
The party commits to reversing Army cuts, increasing defence spending toward 2.5% of GDP, maintaining NATO membership, and supporting Ukraine. Internationally, they advocate rejoining EU programmes, restoring 0.7% aid spending, and pursuing a four-stage roadmap to closer European ties, with eventual EU membership as a longer-term objective.
